description:
Enterprise-grade .NET 8 Web API template with Clean Architecture, comprehensive security features (82% hardened), 
      JWT authentication with token blacklist, role-based access control, SignalR real-time messaging, rate limiting, 
      token versioning, encrypted ticket system for BOLA/IDOR protection, comprehensive audit logging, and configurable 
      session management.
      
      NEW in v1.2.0: Token Blacklist - Proper logout functionality with immediate token invalidation!
      
      Includes: JWT auth with encrypted payloads, token blacklist (logout actually works!), account lockout, 
      comprehensive audit logging (separate database), rate limiting, BOLA/IDOR protection, secrets management, 
      session management, SignalR hub, user invitations, extensive documentation, and security audit tracking.
      
      Perfect for building secure enterprise APIs with modern .NET practices. HIPAA-ready features included.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.2.0 - Token Blacklist Release (82% Security Complete)

🎉 MAJOR NEW FEATURE:
• Token Blacklist - Proper logout functionality that actually works!
  - Immediate token invalidation on logout
  - "Logout all devices" functionality
  - Database-backed with automatic cleanup
  - Background cleanup service (hourly)
  - Works across load-balanced servers
  - No more "JWT tokens can't be revoked" problem

✅ COMPLETED SECURITY FEATURES (16/19):
• JWT Authentication with HS256/RS256 and encrypted payloads (AES-256)
• Token Blacklist with automatic cleanup (NEW - v1.2.0)
• Account Lockout (5 failed attempts, 15-min lockout) (v1.1.0)
• Comprehensive Audit Logging with separate database (v1.1.0)
• Token versioning for session management
• Encrypted ticket system (BOLA/IDOR protection)
• Rate limiting with AspNetCoreRateLimit
• Secrets management (User Secrets, Environment Variables, Key Vault ready)
• Session management (Single/Multiple/Limited modes)
• Role-based authorization (Admin, SuperAdmin, Finance)
• HTTPS enforcement with HSTS
• CORS configuration
• Password security with PBKDF2
• SignalR with JWT authentication
• Configurable identity settings

📈 METRICS:
• Security Score: 82% Complete (16/19 items)
• HIPAA Compliance: 50% Complete
• Production Ready: ✅ Yes

🏗️ ARCHITECTURE:
• Clean Architecture (5 layers)
• CQRS pattern with MediatR
• Repository pattern with EF Core
• PostgreSQL database (main + audit)
• Background services

📚 FEATURES:
• User management with ASP.NET Identity
• Email invitation system
• Multi-device session tracking
• Proper logout (current device & all devices)
• Real-time messaging (SignalR)
• Comprehensive documentation
• Swagger/OpenAPI
• Migration files included
• Secrets generator script

🚧 COMING IN v1.3 (Target: 90% Security):
• Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
• Input Sanitization (XSS protection)
• Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options)
• CSRF Protection

📦 WHAT'S INCLUDED:
• Complete source code with migrations
• Token blacklist implementation
• Audit logging system
• Account lockout system
• Generate-Secrets scripts (.bat & .ps1)
• Comprehensive documentation (12 guides)
• Test controllers for debugging
• Sample implementations

Production-ready .NET 8 Web API template with Clean Architecture, advanced security (82% hardened), 
      JWT auth, token blacklist, proper logout, audit logging, SignalR, and comprehensive documentation.
